metadata.question: On August 6, 2024 at 1:40 pm local time, did land surface temperatures in Paris exceed 32 degrees Celcius?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need land surface temperature (LST) data for Paris on August 6, 2024 at 1:40 pm local time - Paris is in CEST (UTC+2) in August, so 1:40 pm = 13:40 local = 11:40 UTC - MODIS Terra (MOD11A1) passes around 10:30 AM local, Aqua (MYD11A1) passes around 1:30 PM local - Aqua MODIS would be closer to the requested time - Also consider Landsat 8/9 which has thermal bands, or Sentinel-3 SLSTR - Best option: MODIS Aqua (MYD11A1) for LST, or try Landsat 8/9 if available 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds and poor quality pixels using QA bands - MODIS LST products have QA layers for quality control 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - LST should be in reasonable range (e.g., 270-330K or -3 to 57°C for August in Paris) - 32°C = 305.15K - If result is None/NaN → C3 - If no images → C1 - If no valid pixels after masking → C2 - Compare mean/max LST to 32°C threshold ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Paris geometry const paris = ee.Geometry.Point([2.3522, 48.8566]); const parisRegion = paris.buffer(10000); // 10km radius around Paris center // 2. Define time range - August 6, 2024, allowing some flexibility for satellite overpass const targetDate = '2024-08-06'; const startDate = '2024-08-06'; const endDate = '2024-08-07'; console.log('Searching for LST data on August 6, 2024 in Paris...'); // 3. Try MODIS Aqua first (daytime overpass ~1:30 PM local) let collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(paris) .select('LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day'); let collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Aqua images found: ${collectionSize}`); // 4. Fallback to MODIS Terra if Aqua not available if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('Trying MODIS Terra...'); collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(paris) .select('LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day'); collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Terra images found: ${collectionSize}`); } // 5. Try Landsat 8/9 as final fallback if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 8/9...'); const landsat = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(paris) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); collectionSize = landsat.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No images found for the specified date and location.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No data available for August 6, 2024.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Process MODIS LST data const image = collection.first(); // Apply quality mask for MODIS const qaMask = image.select('QC_Day').bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); // Mandatory QA flags const lstMasked = image.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(qaMask); // 7. Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = lstMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: parisRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels after masking: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after quality masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 8. Calculate statistics - MODIS LST is in Kelvin * 0.02 const stats = lstMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.max(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: parisRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanLSTKelvin = stats.get('LST_Day_1km_mean').getInfo(); const maxLSTKelvin = stats.get('LST_Day_1km_max').getInfo(); if (meanLSTKelvin === null || maxLSTKelvin === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - no valid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert from MODIS scale (Kelvin * 0.02) to Celsius const meanLSTCelsius = (meanLSTKelvin * 0.02) - 273.15; const maxLSTCelsius = (maxLSTKelvin * 0.02) - 273.15; console.log(`Mean LST: ${meanLSTCelsius.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Max LST: ${maxLSTCelsius.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Threshold: 32°C`); // Validate reasonable temperature range if (meanLSTCelsius < -50 || meanLSTCelsius > 70 || maxLSTCelsius < -50 || maxLSTCelsius > 70) { console.log('Temperature values out of reasonable range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 9. Final answer - check if temperatures exceeded 32°C if (maxLSTCelsius > 32) { console.log('Land surface temperatures exceeded 32°C.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Land surface temperatures did not exceed 32°C.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
